verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud SaaS work-management product like Linear, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of retention policies, configurable retention periods, or user/admin data-deletion controls. Adjacent items such as version history, private teams, and webhooks for removed data are different capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
